stem: What was one way the role of women in society changed during the 1920s?

options.label: A
options.text: They were granted the right to attend public schools.

options.label: B
options.text: They were allowed to own property.

options.label: C
options.text: They were allowed increased participation in the political process.

options.label: D
options.text: They were granted the right to serve in military combat units.
